videos.description: A kitchen curiosity intrigues wood conservator Will Kirk; a treasured wedding ring that was lost and then found arrives for a much-needed transformation.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: An elegant occasional table owned and loved by a wonderful mother gets the Will Kirk treatment. Plus, a distinctive 1950s radio is sparked back to life, and a pair of very tired suede shoes is tended to by cobbler Dean Westmoreland.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Kirsten Ramsay is entrusted with the rescue of a porcelain figurine of a nurse holding a child.

videos.description: The team fix up festive family treasures, including the only Christmas present received by evacuee Patricia in 1939, a Betty Doll.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Jay Blades and horologist Steve Fletcher work on a timepiece made by a man who was completely blind; Will Kirk restores a fifty-year-old wooden flying fish that may have been carved by a descendant of the mutineers from the HMS Bounty.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Jay Blades and Will Kirk restore a piano stool that's been damaged by a dog; Clock restoration expert Steve is called to work on a vintage telephone; Antique projector specialist Richard Rigby restores a collector's item.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Furniture restorers Jay Blades and Will Kirk take delivery of a highly prized Davenport desk, damaged by burglars and in need of some serious surgery; Vintage electronics expert Neil Fairly battles some aging Doctor Who baddies; The Repair Shop's very own time lord, Steve Fletcher, tackles a tricky time-traveling conundrum of his own.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Ceramics conservator Kirstin Ramsay restores a Victorian garden gnome; Firefighting historian Stuart Black restores an antique helmet; Music box expert Stephen Kember brings a treasured family piece back to life before its owner finds out.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Craftsmen pool their talents and resources to restore heirlooms and treasured antiques such as music boxes, vases and clocks to prove that anything can be restored to their former glory.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Art conservator Lucia Scalisi rescues a painting; Ceramicist Kirsten Ramsay reunites the broken pieces of a plaque that was shattered over forty-five years ago; Furniture restorers Will Kirk and Jay Blades fix a Japanese lacquered jewelry box.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Two royal Worcester vases from the early 1900s; Horologist Steven Fletcher and expert metalworker Dominic Chinea fix a titanic timepiece - the Cirencester village clock; The team mends a piece of farming history, a nineteenth-century hay press.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Clock specialist Steven Fletcher employs his skills to fix a clapping monkey; Ceramicist Kirsten Ramsay and furniture restorer Will Kirk restore a Victorian traveling box; A 1950s Wurlitzer jukebox arrives to test the skills of Laurence Richardson.
